subject: Data retention exception request - FinTechCo (0-retention for PII)
messages:

Hi Alex — great to meet today, and thanks for walking us through the FinTechCo use cases. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Ask we heard: FinTechCo needs strong guarantees around PII and wants an option for 0-retention of raw user inputs (no logs stored).
- Follow-ups: confirm which deployment modes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) can support 0-retention, provide SOC2 evidence, and share retention-exception form for legal to review.
- Proposed near-term: we can start with a retention-exception proposal + security questionnaire, then set up a technical deep-dive with Rafael and Naomi to map config and timeline.

I copied Rafael (SE) and Marissa (CS) so they see the context. I will pull together the retention-exception form and SOC2 summary and get back to you by EOD Tuesday. Can you confirm whether your legal/privacy team wants a contract addendum or just a scoped SOW?

Thanks,

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-06T09:30:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Data handling & retention questions

Thanks Camila — quick clarifications from our privacy team: 

- Primary requirement: 0-retention for any raw user input that may contain PII or account identifiers. We need confirmation that such inputs will not be retained on Redwood servers (or will be immediately deleted) when the customer selects the "0-retention" option.
- Secondary: We can allow ephemeral debug logs for 7 days, provided logs are redacted and access is strictly audited and limited to named personnel.
- Contract ask: prefer a contract addendum stating retention behavior for specific API routes and a defined process for audits.

I cc'd privacy@fintechco.com for record. If you can share SOC2 evidence and a proposed addendum/exception form, we can route to legal. Also: we will likely need data residency guarantees that processed data stays in the US region.

—Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Product, FinTechCo
alex.johnson@fintechco.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>

Subject: FW: Data handling & retention questions (FinTechCo) — need feasibility check

Naomi / Rafael — forwarding Alex's note (excerpted above). High-level asks: 0-retention for PII, 7-day ephemeral debug logs (redacted & audited), and US-only residency. Can we support these for: 

1) Hosted API (PLG) customers
2) Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) customers
3) Private deployment (VPC / on-prem)

Also: Alex asked for a contract addendum / retention-exception form. I can draft the form but need your input for the technical guarantees and fallback language. Target: send proposal to Alex by EOD Mon 8/10 and schedule a tech call week of 8/12.

Thanks — Camila

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-07T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Data handling & retention questions (FinTechCo) — proposed options

Camila — summary of options and recommended path: 

Options (feasibility/notes):
- Private deployment (VPC or on-prem): FULL 0-retention is feasible. Customer controls persistence; we can ship a package that does not write raw inputs to long-term storage. Requires standard Private onboarding (2-3 weeks) + legal addendum.

- Dedicated (reserved capacity): We can offer route-level 0-retention for specific endpoints by configuring the serving runtime to bypass persistent request logs and not write request payloads to long-term storage. Short-term ephemeral traces for debugging can be enabled but we will: redact identified PII fields, expire traces after configured window, and restrict access via IAM. This will require a small engineering change to ensure KV cache and metrics don’t persist raw inputs — estimated ~1-2 weeks for scoped change + testing.

- Hosted (shared): 0-retention for raw inputs is NOT recommended as a general product option because of multi-tenant operational constraints. However we can offer masked/redacted input retention and a 7-day ephemeral debug window with audited access. If FinTechCo requires strict 0-retention, recommend Dedicated or Private.

Required artifacts & next steps:
1) Have FinTechCo fill the retention-exception-form (attached) to specify routes and payload types covered.
2) Provide SOC2 summary and evidence (attached).
3) Legal to draft an addendum describing the retention behavior and audit process.
4) Tech call with Rafael + FinTechCo engineering to map endpoints and confirm required engineering changes.

Timeline: once we get the completed form and confirm deployment mode, estimate 1-3 weeks to deliver the configuration and legal addendum depending on Dedicated vs Private.

Let me know if you want me on the call with FinTechCo.

—Naomi Feldman
Director, InfoSec | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Data retention exception request - FinTechCo (0-retention for PII)

Alex — thanks for the clear notes. Per internal review (below) we have three options and a proposed next steps list: 

1) Private deployment (recommended for strict 0-retention): Full 0-retention achievable. Onboarding ~2-3 weeks; legal addendum required.
2) Dedicated (middle ground): Route-level 0-retention possible with a scoped engineering change (~1-2 weeks) + addendum. Ephemeral debug logs (7 days) can be enabled with redaction and audited access.
3) Hosted: We cannot guarantee full 0-retention for hosted multi-tenant customers. We can offer redaction + 7-day ephemeral debug logs only.

Next steps I propose: 
- Please have your legal/privacy team complete the attached retention-exception-form to list the exact routes and payloads covered (attached).
- If you prefer Private or Dedicated, confirm preferred deployment mode and we will kick off the technical runbook and legal addendum.
- Schedule a technical call: Rafael + Naomi + FinTechCo engs — proposed slot Tue Aug 12 10:00am PT. Please confirm availability.

I attached the retention-exception-form and our SOC2 summary for your legal/privacy review. Once we have the filled form I will open a HubSpot task (link below) and route to Legal for the addendum draft.
